source: certo cria um campo de futebol

image_prompt.text: Touchlines and goal lines painted as a crisp rectangular perimeter defining the pitch
A centre circle and kick-off spot, plus penalty spots, where play restarts
A goal mouth at each end of the pitch — posts, crossbar and net
Painted field markings dividing the pitch: halfway line, penalty areas, corner arcs

layout_placement.text: A detection perimeter on the touchlines and goal lines so play pauses the moment the ball crosses out
Static reset positions for kick-off at the centre circle and for penalty kicks
A scoring volume filling each goal mouth that registers a goal

notes: Regulation pitch dimensions are a known fixed spec, so parametric placement of the field beats free image generation here (P6-lite generator choice, not a routing change).
Prompt names only the object, in Portuguese, with no play mode and no dressing — everything beyond the bare pitch is preset-derived.
